input.title: dedup-prune-integrity doesn't exempt provenance/ appends from its shrink-only check
input.body:
`.claudinite/shared/packs/claudinite-growth/workRules/dedup-integrity.mjs`'s shrink-only measurement (part 2) flags any local-pack `.md` file that grew in a branch whose commits mention "dedup", with no exemption for a pack's own `provenance/*.md` files.

But the growth-dedup task's own skill (`packs/claudinite-growth/skills/growth-dedup/SKILL.md`, "Discipline") *requires* recording every prune/strip/rephrase on the element's provenance file, in the same change, via `provenance.mjs append` — which necessarily grows that file (it's an append-only log). So any dedup run that correctly follows the provenance-recording discipline for a real (non-empty) prune trips this check, since the growth check doesn't distinguish a provenance log's expected append-growth from an actual local pack prose file (RULES.md/SKILL.md) improperly growing.

Hit on PR #1360 (growth-dedup, work item #1349): rephrased `.claudinite/local/packs/gcec/skills/merge-and-ci/SKILL.md` (which itself shrank, 8245→8233 chars) and appended the mandated entry to `.claudinite/local/packs/gcec/provenance/merge-and-ci.md` (98→108 lines) in the same commit. `check_the_work.mjs` blocked at Stop with:

```
[BLOCKING] dedup-prune-integrity  .claudinite/local/packs/gcec/provenance/merge-and-ci.md
  a dedup run grew .claudinite/local/packs/gcec/provenance/merge-and-ci.md from 98 to 108 lines
```

This is `scope: 'work'` (Stop-hook only, not run in CI's `check_the_world.mjs`), so it didn't block the PR's merge — but it will block every future growth-dedup session's own Stop hook the same way, for any run that legitimately prunes something and records why.

Suggested fix: exclude paths under a pack's `provenance/` directory from the shrink-only measurement (part 2), while still allowing the canon-restatement fingerprint (part 1) to scan them, since a provenance entry restating the canon rule verbatim would be a real corruption too.

_Filed by the Claudinite task `claudinite-growth/growth-dedup`, running as work item missingbulb/GoogleCalendarEventCreator#1349 — no person asked for this issue._
